authority.source_authority: Albert remains authoritative for source meaning; DAD owns only privacy-safe reusable copies, metadata, candidate lessons, and generated graph projections.

non_overlap_statement: Only primary-ingestion-writer may edit the isolated DAD worktree; source and overlap specialists plus the checker are read-only, and Albert is never mutated.

roles.why_needed: A deterministic-first Luna lane can cover the approved Albert governance surfaces cheaply without exposing case material.
roles.mission: Inventory tracked reusable candidates, exact source revisions and hashes, privacy exclusions, and stable private-reference metadata without reading prohibited content.
inputs: source Git revision and dirty-state digest
roles.authority: Read-only Albert access limited to tracked governance, learning, configuration, schema, validator, synthetic-fixture, and manifest surfaces; no private workspace or case payload reads.
acceptance_conditions: Every candidate has a disposition or explicit unreviewed state.
Every prohibited path class is excluded with counts only.
stop_conditions: A candidate requires case content, OCR text, private workspace contents, credentials, or source mutation.

readiness_conditions: Source revision and coverage boundary are explicit.

roles.why_needed: Terra-level synthesis is needed to reuse DAD authorities and map source candidates into stable identities and typed graph edges without creating competing registries.
roles.mission: Compare Albert candidates with DAD lessons, assets, skills, workflows, schemas, registries, graphs, and TOCs, then recommend reuse, revision, safe copy, reference-only, or rejection.
roles.authority: Read-only synthesis; cannot copy, register, promote, or approve candidates.
acceptance_conditions: No competing authority or duplicate capability is proposed.
Typed edges preserve provenance, review state, and reverse consumers.
stop_conditions: Identity, privacy, license, or authority cannot be resolved from permitted evidence.

readiness_conditions: Reuse and non-reuse decisions cite exact DAD evidence.

roles.why_needed: One writer must keep schema, deterministic inventory, safe-copy package, graph, registries, navigation, tests, and evidence coherent.
roles.mission: Implement the governed ingestion capability and materialize a DAD-owned privacy-safe Albert snapshot with deterministic validation and complete navigation.
roles.authority: May edit only the isolated DAD worktree; may read only approved Albert sources; may not mutate downstream repositories or promote candidates without review.
acceptance_conditions: All reviewed candidates have provenance and disposition.
Safe copies and graph outputs reproduce deterministically.
DAD validation and focused tests pass.
stop_conditions: Private or case content would enter DAD.
A source-authority conflict requires a human decision.

readiness_conditions: Writer validation passes and privacy scan is clean.

roles.why_needed: A separate Terra/high review is required for source coverage, false authority, privacy leakage, graph completeness, and ingestion reproducibility.
roles.mission: Independently replay permitted-source coverage, hashes, classifications, deduplication, graph links, TOC routing, privacy exclusions, rollback, and downstream non-mutation evidence.
roles.authority: Read-only final review; cannot edit, promote, mutate Albert, or rely on writer self-grades.
acceptance_conditions: Issues are returned as PROCEED, REPAIR, or explicit human escalation with reproducible evidence.

readiness_conditions: All permitted artifacts and deterministic receipts are available.

proof_obligations.description: Every approved or deterministically discovered reusable candidate is copied safely, referenced, deduplicated, rejected, or explicitly left unknown with provenance.
Every retained candidate is reachable through registries, typed graph projections, reverse-consumer links, the AI front door, and the TOC without gaining false authority.
No case, OCR, witness, client, credential, raw-conversation, or ignored-private content enters DAD, and Albert remains source authority.
